title: What's the Weather Like?
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Good morning, Adam. Is it sunny today?
dialogue.translation_ar: صباح الخير يا آدم. هل الجو مشمس اليوم؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Good morning, Lina. Yes, the sun is bright.
dialogue.translation_ar: صباح الخير يا لينا. نعم، الشمس ساطعة.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What is the temperature?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: It is twenty-five degrees.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: That is warm, but not too hot.
dialogue.translation_ar: هذا دافئ لكنه ليس حارًا جدًا.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Do you want to walk outside?
dialogue.translation_ar: هل تريد أن تتمشى في الخارج؟

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Yes, but I need my sunglasses.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، لكنني أحتاج إلى نظارتي الشمسية.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Do you like summer?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I like summer, but I love spring more.
dialogue.translation_ar: أحب الصيف، لكنني أحب الربيع أكثر.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Why do you love spring?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: The flowers are beautiful, and the air is cool.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I like autumn. The leaves change color.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What about winter?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Winter is cold here, and sometimes it rains.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you have an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, I keep a small one in my bag.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم، أحتفظ بمظلة صغيرة في حقيبتي.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Look! There are clouds in the sky.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Maybe it will rain this afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Let's check the weather before we go.
dialogue.translation_ar: لنتحقق من حالة الطقس قبل أن نذهب.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Good idea. We can walk after lunch.
dialogue.translation_ar: فكرة جيدة. يمكننا المشي بعد الغداء.

questions.question: Which season does Adam love most?
